verifiedScope.proxy: Chrestomanci novel first-book-publication span, from Charmed Life to The Pinhoe Egg, used as a publishing proxy rather than a claim of uninterrupted work or a full-career span. The six markers use first English-language book years, not composition, fictional chronology, serialization, translation or later omnibus/reissue dates. The Lives of Christopher Chant appeared in 1988, before the 2000 retitled edition and 2001 omnibus. Mixed Magics (2000) collects short stories and is excluded from this novel-only bar. Earlier and later novels outside Chrestomanci, other series, plays, nonfiction and posthumous releases do not extend this scoped span. The Islands of Chaldea (2014), completed by her sister Ursula after Jones’s death, is outside it.
